courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「砂塵沉積與清理週期」與「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" and "Platform storage and queue conservation" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沙漠高速線砂塵熱量與旅客尖峰；摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路則以新興高速走廊既有線銜接與能源為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on desert high speed sand heat and pilgrimage demand; Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway centres on emerging high speed corridor interfaces and energy, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「砂塵沉積與清理週期」與「快慢車追及與待避」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” and “Fast-slow train catch-up”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

以「垂直動線有效輸送率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” and “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 麥加—麥地那高速鐵路
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2018 年：哈拉曼高速鐵路開始商業旅客服務；2021 年：沙烏地鐵路公司重組形成整合營運背景。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以麥加至麥地那高速鐵路為背景，建立高溫、砂塵及集中旅客到達並存的教學案例。學徒把進氣過濾、散熱、供電和月台人流連結，在集中特殊需求下檢查系統瓶頸；所有人數與氣候數值均為自訂算例而非營運資料。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2018: Haramain high-speed railway began commercial passenger service; 2021: Saudi railway restructuring established an integrated operating context. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Haramain high-speed corridor to frame a teaching case combining heat, airborne sand and concentrated passenger arrivals. Connect intake filtration, cooling, power supply and platform flow under exceptional demand. All passenger and weather numbers are invented exercises, and students must distinguish a bottleneck revealed by a model from a verified constraint on the actual railway. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「砂塵沉積與清理週期」到「周轉時間與車隊需求」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" through "Round-trip time and fleet size" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
